info.description: Stateless micro-service for course/module content delivery.
info.title: Course Service API

post.summary: Clear the entire git content cache (admin)
Create or update a course from a markdown document (admin)
Preview what a markdown document would import (admin)

get.summary: Get a learning path's full definition (admin)

post.summary: Clear the git cache for all repos used by a course (admin)

get.summary: Export a course as a markdown document (admin)

post.summary: Clear the git cache for a specific module (admin)
Add a session to a course (admin or manager)

put.summary: Update a session on a course (admin or manager)

delete.summary: Delete a session from a course (admin or manager)

get.summary: Resolve several courses by slug in one request
Resolve several learning paths by slug in one request
List the modules of several skills in one request

post.summary: Submit quiz answers for a module

parameters.description: Max paths to return (0 means unlimited)
parameters.name: limit

get.summary: Get a learning path by slug
List all modules tagged with a given skill

inline.description: quiz rendered inside the previous module

prerequisites.description: module slugs that must be completed first

courses.description: ordered — index N+1 unlocks after N completed

order.description: type order: item IDs in user order

markdown.description: Markdown is the whole document, pasted or read from a file.

mode.description: Mode is create, replace or append. Empty means create.

slug.description: Slug overrides the slug the document's frontmatter declares.

split.description:
Split names the heading level that starts a new module: none, h1,
h2, h3, h4, h5 or h6. Empty falls back to the document's own
`split` key, then to none.

existing.description:
Existing marks a module that was already stored and is being kept,
so an append preview shows where the new ones land.
